changelog: 📱 Android Notification Stability & Zero Spam: Eliminated repeated 10-second re-posting to stop notification history spam (no more 5-7 duplicates per minute) and flickering; Android OS Chronometer counts down/up natively in hardware
👆 Swipe-to-Dismiss Notifications: Made active timer notifications fully dismissable (ongoing: false, autoCancel: true) so you can swipe away the notification from your shade whenever you want
🎨 Inter Normal Universal Default Font: Imported Inter (weights 400, 500, 600, 700) and set it as the universal default typeface across the entire app for clean, crisp legibility
⚡ Calendar-Day Startup Update Check: Checks for updates exactly once on the first app launch of each calendar day, consuming < 1 KB of data (< 30 KB/month) and skipping subsequent opens
🎯 Mandatory Task Binding: No focus session (Pomodoro, Countdown, Flow) can start without choosing a task in both Focus view and desktop Timer Popout
✨ Clean UI & Dedicated Session Editor: Removed distracting link/change chips from Day Log and Focus; added compact edit modal in Today's Focus Log and Calendar to adjust duration and start/end times
📅 Google Calendar Side-by-Side Columns: Overlapping tasks cleanly split side-by-side (| Task 1 | Task 2 |) across the full width of the day column
⏱️ Uncapped Focus Overtime Tracking: Sessions never freeze at target time; live overtime counter (+MM:SS) tracks true elapsed time with dedicated 'Finish' button
📐 Accurate Duration Drag & 15m Resizing: Dragging from tray or grid previews the exact task duration height; bottom-edge handles allow 15-minute duration resizing
